title: Weak Hoeffding log-MGF bound
statement:
Let $n \ge 1$ and let $p = (p_1, \dots, p_n)$ be a probability vector, so that $p_i \ge 0$ for every $i$ and $\sum_{i} p_i = 1$. Let $\ell_1, \dots, \ell_n \in [0,1]$, and let $\eta > 0$. Writing $L = \sum_{i} p_i \ell_i$ for the average loss, one has
\[
  \log\!\Bigl(\sum_{i} p_i\, e^{-\eta\, \ell_i}\Bigr)
  \;\le\;
  -\eta L + \frac{\eta^2}{2}.
\]
replaced:
Let $p$ be a probability vector on $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ and let $\ell_i \in [0,1]$ for all
$i$.  For $\eta > 0$, setting $L = \sum_i p_i \ell_i$,
\[
  \ln\!\Bigl(\sum_{i} p_i\,e^{-\eta\,\ell_i}\Bigr)
  \;\le\;
  -\eta L + \frac{\eta^2}{2}.
\]
